thread:
tanya: Quick sync: PM wants a compact "cost quickpeek" in the route UI. Goal: select a routing change (e.g., shift 30% to cheaper-quant) and get instant cost delta + cache-savings estimate. Low latency, low cardinality. Feasibility?
ben: doable. Need per-model/route 1m rollups: tokens, cached_prefix_hits, seq_len_bucket_fracs (4 buckets), and p50/p95 latency. Keep tenant off these rollups to avoid explosion.
omar: agree. Suggest emitter names: router.tokens{model,route}, router.cache_hits{model,route}, router.seq_buckets{model,route}. MV updated every 3-5m. Simulator reads last N minutes and scales.
ivy: API sketch: POST /internal/simulate/quickpeek {model,route,delta_pct,window_mins,cache_override?}. Response: {cost_delta, token_delta, cache_savings, ci, top_factors}. Keep response minimal.
ux-marc: UI: tiny inline control: slider 0-100% + toggle prefetch. Show three succinct numbers and an "Explain" chevron. Also a CTA "Apply to canary" prefill. Keep default confidence band displayed.
ben: perf note: avoid heavy histograms. Use 4 fixed seq buckets e.g. [0-64,65-256,257-1024,>1024]. Store bucket fractions. Simulation math: per-bucket token * per-token-cost * (1 - cache_credit).
tanya: rollout: feature-flag beta orgs, compare predicted vs observed next-24h for validation. Emit sim_request_count and sim_error_pct.
omar: security: gate to platform admins; redact raw token counts for org viewers.
analytics-bot: created ticket CFG-4312 assigned to ben/omar.
ivy: will draft proto and small example payload. aiming for MVP in 3 weeks (lean: use last-5m aggregates on demand).
tanya: great. please post proto + sample response in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
